## What changed

Describe the vendor, terminology, standard, claim, taxonomy, or evidence change.

## Research checklist

- [ ] Canonical records use existing taxonomy values where possible.
- [ ] Material facts have evidence records.
- [ ] Evidence uses the strongest available primary/official source.
- [ ] `captured_at`, `observed_at`, and `last_verified` dates are current.
- [ ] Vendor marketing superlatives were not converted into facts.
- [ ] Unknown facts are omitted and recorded in `research_gaps` instead of guessed.
- [ ] Rebrands, parent ownership, and product names are represented explicitly where relevant.
- [ ] Important reusable facts are represented as `claims/` records.
- [ ] Terminology changes include aliases and an ADR when they affect Spotwo product language.
- [ ] Generated matrices and audit views were refreshed.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes locally.
- [ ] `python scripts/generate_matrices.py --check` passes locally.
- [ ] `python scripts/generate_audit.py --check` passes locally.
